name: Composite Cross Domain Variant 2
task:
Please complete the following four-stage multi-domain task.

A university's strategic plan (30 pages): enrollment 15,000, tuition $12K/student, 5 colleges. Each proposes expansion: Engineering ($5M, 200 new students), Business ($3M, 150 students), Arts ($2M, 100 students). Budget: $8M.

Calculate NPV of the investment.

Optimize budget allocation.

Recommend the best course of action.
